_comment: Per-talk-clip speaking window, in ms. speakStartMs = when the mouth starts moving; speakEndMs = when talking stops; talkLen = end-start drives how many clips cover a line. Cel set (2026-10-07): every talk clip was generated to mouth words the whole way through, so the window is the clip minus a short lead-in and lead-out (estimated, not measured). Keyed by clip stem.
